# Kodiak Richards

> Therapist-in-training and integrative coach in San Diego, CA, and founder of Pocket of Humanity, a human-first mental wellness community. Works with creatives, entrepreneurs, and growth-oriented adults on nervous system regulation, trauma and emotions, attachment and relationships, burnout, digital wellness, and purpose.

Background: M.A. Clinical Mental Health Counseling (Concordia University Irvine), B.S. Psychology, certified nutritionist, certified personal trainer. Approaches include IFS (Internal Family Systems), somatic and trauma-informed work, ACT, polyvagal-informed nervous system regulation, and HRV biofeedback. Coaching is separate from licensed psychotherapy and provided under licensed clinical supervision for California residents.
